row.evidence: Dropbox's Microsoft Entra ID article, which covers provisioning and deprovisioning team members, "applies to admins on Dropbox Standard, Business, Advanced, Business Plus, and Enterprise", and Microsoft's tutorial calls it "the new SCIM 2.0 Dropbox integration which supports Groups".
row.notes: Status changed from June (gated) to free: IdP provisioning is on Standard ($15/user/mo annual), the lowest team plan, with no add-on. June recorded the same Standard plan for SCIM and for the team plan, so the gated label did not follow the rules. SSO has moved: the plans page now lists Single sign-on only on Advanced ($24/user/mo annual) and Enterprise, so Standard teams can provision via SCIM without SSO. Dropbox does not publish its own SCIM reference; the SCIM 2.0 connector is documented by Microsoft (Tenant URL + Secret Token) and Okta's OIN app (SCIM create/update/deactivate/group push). Google Admin console provisioning is documented for Business/Business Plus. Standard now starts at 1 user (June: 3-user minimum); Advanced needs 3+. The Dropbox AD Connector is retired on 1 Dec 2026 in favour of Entra ID.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Individual plan, no team admin console.

auth.notes: Entra uses a Dropbox Tenant URL and Secret Token; Dropbox does not document where the token is generated.

operations.notes: Okta OIN app shows SCIM Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking (rendered page). Update method (PUT/PATCH) not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: Suspended members keep data and sharing relationships; deleting the member frees the license and files can be transferred or kept as a Basic account.
deprovision.notes: IdP disable maps to suspend per Microsoft's connector note; suspended users still count as a licence until deleted.

attributes.notes: Attribute mappings are shown only as screenshots in Microsoft's tutorial.

limitations.text: Suspending an invited (not yet joined) user deletes that user.
Provisioned members must accept an invitation before joining.
Entra group sync requires Microsoft Entra ID Premium.

scim.notes: sso_required false is inferred: provisioning is on Standard while SSO is Advanced+.

endpoints.purpose: Remove a member (optionally keep as Basic account, transfer files)

audit_log_api.notes: team_log/get_events; the plans page lists 'Audit logs with file event tracking' on Advanced+ only.

limitations.text: Removed members can be recovered for 7 days.

user_api.notes: RPC-style JSON over HTTPS POST (Dropbox Business API).

okta.notes: OIN 'Dropbox Business' shows SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking checked (rendered page).

google.notes: Google Admin console Dropbox Business app; provisioning protocol not documented.

onelogin.notes: Dropbox lists OneLogin as offering preconfigured SSO settings; provisioning not documented by Dropbox.

open_questions: Dropbox does not publish its SCIM endpoint, token location, attribute list or filtering support; only the IdP pages describe the SCIM connector.
Docs do not say what Okta deactivation does (suspend vs remove).
Google Admin console provisioning protocol and plan names (Business/Business Plus) are not mapped to the current Standard/Advanced names.
Dropbox Business API rate limits are not stated on the pages reviewed.
